findings.finding: The Rasharkin Second Presbyterian memorial erected by James Garvin Glasgo names his father John, mother Margaret Garvin and infant son John Garvin; it gives John a death date of 20 June 1895 aged 78.
James Garvin Glasgow's 1886 marriage names father John Glasgow, farmer; his 1918 death was registered by widow Eliza Ann.
Alexander Glasgow-2385's 1847 marriage names father John Glasgow, labourer. Alexander was an adult contemporary of Glasgow-867 and must be detached as his son.
